Basis: The GRETIL header reads 'Nagarjuna: Bhavasamkrantiparikatha', from Aiyaswami Sastri's 1938 edition; Pandit 88361 is Bhavasamkrāntiśāstra by Nāgārjuna (85145), the only Bhavasaṃkrānti by him. The title ending differs (-parikathā vs -śāstra) and 88361's 'commentary on Abhidharmasamuccaya' field looks wrong, so not confirmed beyond author plus title stem.

Searched Bharata, Bharatamuni, Bharata Muni; Nāṭyaśāstra 96216 has no author in Pandit. The only bare 'Bharata' is 40563 (aka Hindupati, no works or dates), which nothing ties to the Nāṭyaśāstra; 102242 Bharatapāla (1125) is someone else.
Searched Āpattideśanāvidhi, Āpattideśanā, Āpatti, Deśanāvidhi and read the 28 works Pandit lists under Atīśa (85364); none is this text.
Searched Ṛtusaṃhāra, Ṛtusaṃhāram, Ritusamhara and grepped the CSV for 'tusaṃhā'; nothing found, and it is not among the nine works listed under Kālidāsa (40377).
Searched Vallālacarita, Ballālacarita, Vallāla, Ballāla and grepped the CSV for 'allālac'; only unrelated near spellings (Bālacarita 97252, Mahīpālacaritra 42309) came back.

Pandit has 87078 Ānanda Bhaṭṭa (Vedāntakaumudī on the Vijñānabhairava) and 87079 Ānanda Bhaṭṭa Upādhyāya (Īśā Upaniṣad bhāṣya), both undated and with no Vallālacarita; nothing ties either to the Bengali author of the Vallālacarita, so I take him to be absent, but 87078 is a same-name near miss I could not rule out.

Searched Bṛhatkathāślokasaṃgraha, Bṛhatkathā, Ślokasaṃgraha and grepped the CSV for 'Bṛhatkath'. Only 95967 Bṛhatkathā exists, which is a different work (and is linked as a base text of a Jain ṭīkā, 89676), not Budhasvāmin's Ślokasaṃgraha.
Searched Buddhasvāmin and Budhasvāmin and grepped the CSV for both spellings; only other -svāmin names (Bhaṭṭasvāmin 110153, Devasvāmin 85344) and Buddhasena 85150 came back.

The only hit is 105866 Brahmasiddhisphuṭasiddhāntodāharaṇa (Jyotiḥśāstra, no author), which by its name is an udāharaṇa on the text, not the text itself; 95097 Brahmasiddhānta is a Vedānta work by Kātyāyana.
Searched Brahmagupta and grepped the CSV for 'Brahmagupt' and for persons beginning Brahm-/Jiṣṇu; no such person, and Khaṇḍakhādya (106029) has no author in Pandit either.
